notes: Box score from the Dallas Mavericks' 116–114 road win over the Utah Jazz on Sunday, Nov 22, 2026, from the Covers.com box score. All 116 Dallas points and all 114 Utah points add up from the player lines, and the quarter scores (33–31–27–25 to 35–22–17–40) add up to both totals: Dallas led 64–57 at the half and 91–74 after three (Covers; Dallas Sports Journal; Ball Exclusives). The CBS Sports box score had not loaded its stats, so the main lines were checked against the written stories instead: Flagg's 28 on 8 of 17, 3 of 7 and 9 of 10 (Dallas Sports Journal; Deseret News), Irving's 16 and 8 assists (AP; Dallas Sports Journal), Risacher, Martin, Gafford and Marshall (Dallas Sports Journal; SB Nation), Mykhailiuk's 39 on 12 of 23 and 10 of 15 from three (Dallas Sports Journal; Deseret News; AP), and the team field goals, rebounds and free throws (VAVEL). Steals (16–6, a Dallas season high per Dallas Sports Journal), turnovers (11–23), points in the paint (50–42), fast-break points (19–18), assists (32–31), threes (16 of 42 to 18 of 45), free throws (14 of 17 to 16 of 25), rebounds (34–50) and both biggest leads (Dallas 18, Utah 6) are from Covers. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Sunday's games.

Dallas went on a 20–5 run in the third quarter to lead 80–62 (AP), and led 104–86 with 6:25 left (Dallas Sports Journal). Utah then scored the last 16 points of regulation: Isaiah Collier's driving layup with 4.7 seconds left tied it 114–114 (AP; Dallas Sports Journal), after Svi Mykhailiuk's threes with about 37 and 15.2 seconds left (Dallas Sports Journal) and Flagg's inbound pass out of bounds at 10.2 seconds (Dallas Sports Journal; KMJ). Mykhailiuk scored a career-high 39 off the bench, 23 in the fourth quarter; his 10 threes are one off the Utah franchise record and tied for the most in an NBA game this season (AP; Dallas Sports Journal). Dallas forced 23 turnovers and scored 32 points off them (AP). All five Dallas starters scored in double figures (SB Nation). It was Dallas' third straight win, the second night of a back-to-back after beating the Clippers on Saturday, and its first road win after four straight road losses (AP; SB Nation; Dallas Sports Journal; Basketball-Reference). P.J. Washington sat out (AP and Dallas Sports Journal say illness); Utah's Jaxson Hayes left in the second quarter with a knee injury (AP). Dallas plays at Denver on Tuesday, Nov 24 at 10:00 PM ET; Utah plays at the Lakers on Monday (Covers; AP).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Cooper Flagg's two free throws after Ace Bailey fouled him (Dallas Sports Journal; Deseret News; SB Nation). Dallas Sports Journal, the Deseret News and Field Level Media's story (KMJ) give 3.6 seconds left; AP and ABC4 give 3.7. The board's Tied to Mavericks +2 is 114–114 to 116–114. Kyle Filipowski's 29-foot three for Utah missed at the horn (Dallas Sports Journal; AP). The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Dallas Mavericks or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Cooper Flagg's listed 6-foot-9 and 205 pounds with No. 32 (Wikipedia), arms scaled to the 7-foot wingspan measured at the 2025 NBA Draft Combine (BasketNews). He is drawn in Dallas' road blue with the default figure (no look on the look sheet yet). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
